ex.s: Though now regarded as one of the greatest American novels, the book sold poorly to begin with and Fitzgerald died before it received acclaim.

ex.s: Benjamin could read only a little,having been a poor student.But he later said,”Those two books were my companions by day,and under my pillow at night.”While it is likely that he understood very little of the books,they were his introduction to classical paintings.The nine-year-old boy decided then that he would be an artist.
ex.t: 本杰明只读过一点书，因为他曾是个差学生。但他后来说：“那两本书白天是我的伙伴，晚上就在我的枕头下。”虽然他很可能几乎看不懂那些书，但它们是他接触古典绘画的入门。这个九岁男孩当时就下定决心要成为一名艺术家。

ex.s: Around the world, people are adapting in surprising ways, especially in some poor countries.
ex.t: 世界各地的人们正在以令人惊讶的方式适应，特别是在一些贫穷国家。

defs.def: people who have very little money 贫困者；穷人

ex.s: The government has struggled to come up with measures to address the problem, particularly in the poorer, rural areas east of the Volga River, including arranging doctor’s appointments by video chat and expanding financial aid programs to motivate doctors to practice medicine in remote parts of the country like Krasnoyarsk.
ex.t: 政府努力想出措施解决这个问题，尤其是在伏尔加河以东较贫困的农村地区，包括通过视频聊天安排医生预约，并扩大财政援助项目以激励医生到克拉斯诺亚尔斯克等偏远地区行医。

ex.s: This December, all the toys they made were distributed to local charities to be handed out to children from poor families.
ex.t: 今年12月，他们制作的所有玩具都被分发给了当地慈善机构，再由慈善机构发给贫困家庭的儿童。

ex.s: You may not know over 30% of the world's food is wasted, while many people in poor areas do not have enough to eat.
ex.t: 你可能不知道，全世界超过30%的食物被浪费了，而贫困地区的许多人却没有足够的食物吃。
